## Activity

During November 2023, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 442 captures as part of routine service activity. This represents the total number of image captures recorded at the site for the month. The activity was reviewed alongside image quality and grading outcomes to support monitoring of service delivery.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 18 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.1 per cent. These results should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality assurance, with attention given to any recurring problems affecting image capture or assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 116 referable results. The median wait from photograph to grade was 2 days. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during November 2023.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will help maintain a clear operational record and support follow-up where equipment problems affect image quality or service activity.
